integrity: The verifier reconstructs the exact complex from all 100 tetrahedra, proves H1 is Z plus Z/3 by integral Smith reduction, certifies independent free and mod-three coordinates, and exhausts every three-vertex clique.
scientific_limitations: The result is specific to the published seventeen-vertex G3 triangulation and to simple cycles measured by edge length. The displayed splitting of H1 into a free generator and an order-three generator is explicitly certified but not canonical.
title: Odd torsion splits the triangular systoles of the seventeen-vertex flat manifold \(\mathcal G_3\)
